integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the source's Pauli contraction, utility, and fidelity identities plus Shannon's grouping identity; finite computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Pure binary qubit inputs with equal priors only.
Full Pauli channels in the source's adapted frame; no claim for arbitrary mixed-unitary channels.
Shannon key entropy is an asymptotic randomness measure, not a fractional fixed-length one-shot key length.
title: Exact key-entropy frontier for fidelity-constrained binary Pauli randomization
